purpose: Role-specific searches for software, systems analysis, support, and administrative vacancies across original ATS boards and direct job portals. ATS queries use a rolling date filter.

groups.label: Full Stack
groups.query: ("Full Stack Engineer" OR "Full Stack Developer" OR "Software Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "Angular" OR "Node.js")

groups.label: Frontend
groups.query: ("Frontend Developer" OR "Frontend Engineer" OR "Desenvolvedor Frontend" OR "Desenvolvedor Front-end" OR "Angular Developer" OR "React Developer") ("TypeScript" OR "JavaScript" OR "Angular" OR "React")

groups.label: Analista de Sistemas
groups.query: ("Analista de Sistemas" OR "Analista de Sistemas de Informação" OR "Systems Analyst") (SQL OR APIs OR integração OR integrações OR sistemas)

groups.label: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas
groups.query: ("Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas" OR "Analista Desenvolvedor" OR "Desenvolvedor de Sistemas") (Java OR Spring OR TypeScript OR SQL OR APIs)

groups.label: Desenvolvedor de Software
groups.query: ("Desenvolvedor de Software" OR "Engenheiro de Software" OR "Software Developer" OR "Software Engineer") (TypeScript OR JavaScript OR Java OR Go OR APIs)

groups.label: Suporte a Sistemas / Aplicações N2
groups.query: ("Suporte a Sistemas" OR "Suporte a Aplicações" OR "Analista de Suporte N2" OR "Application Support Analyst") (SQL OR MySQL OR chamados OR APIs OR incidentes)

groups.label: Suporte Técnico N1/N2
groups.query: ("Suporte Técnico N2" OR "Analista de Suporte Técnico" OR "Técnico de Suporte" OR "Service Desk Analyst" OR "Help Desk") (Windows OR Microsoft 365 OR Active Directory OR DNS OR DHCP OR hardware OR redes)

groups.label: Assistente / Auxiliar Administrativo
groups.query: ("Assistente Administrativo" OR "Auxiliar Administrativo" OR "Administrative Assistant" OR "Administrative Clerk")

groups.label: UX / Product Design
groups.query: ("Product Designer" OR "UX Designer" OR "UI/UX Designer" OR "UX Engineer" OR "Product Design") ("UX" OR "user research" OR "Figma" OR "usability")

groups.label: Applied AI
groups.query: ("AI Product Engineer" OR "Applied AI Engineer" OR "AI Software Engineer" OR "Full Stack Engineer") ("LLM" OR "GenAI" OR "AI" OR "TypeScript")

groups.label: Founding / Early Engineer
groups.query: ("Founding Engineer" OR "Founding Software Engineer" OR "Early Engineer" OR "First Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "AI")
